title: Croydon Half-Light
description: A half-time 140 roller where the drums lead: intricate euclidean 606 hats, ghost toms and skippy claps drive a dark dubstep skeleton while a wobbling sub and a clipped square stab carry the soul. It climbs to a peak, drops into a sparse valley of rims and space, then surges to a second, dirtier peak before stripping back to the bare pulse.
code:
setcpm(140/4)
arrange(
  [16, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.9),
    s("hh(5,16,2)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).swingBy(0.18, 16).hpf(6000),
    n("0").scale("C2:minor").s("sine").lpf(420).gain(0.8).struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x")
  )],
  [24, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.95),
    s("hh(7,16,3)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.6).swingBy(0.2, 16).hpf(5500).pan(sine.range(0.35,0.65)),
    s("~ ~ cp ~ ~ ~ ~ cp").gain(0.55).room(0.25),
    s("lt(3,8,2)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.45).coarse(3).every(4, x => x.ply(2)),
    n("0 ~ 3 0").scale("C2:minor").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(300, 900)).gain(0.85).struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").shape(0.2)
  )],
  [32, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.0),
    s("hh(9,16,4)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.62).swingBy(0.2, 16).hpf(5000).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.3,0.7)),
    s("oh ~ ~ oh ~ ~ oh ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.4).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ ~ ~ ~ cp ~").gain(0.6).room(0.3).every(8, x => x.ply("<1 2>")),
    s("lt(5,16,3) ht(3,8)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.5).coarse(4).sometimesBy(0.25, x => x.speed(1.5)),
    n("0 ~ 3 0").scale("C2:minor").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(4).range(350, 1100)).gain(0.9).struct("x ~ x x ~ x ~ x").shape(0.3),
    n("<0 3 5 7>").scale("C4:dorian").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(saw.slow(2).range(0.3, 0.75)).struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").crush(7).lpf(2200)
  )],
  [16, stack(
    s("~ ~ cp ~ ~ ~ ~ ~").gain(0.5).room(0.5).delay(".4:.125:.6"),
    s("hh(3,8,1)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.4).swingBy(0.2, 8).hpf(6500),
    n("<[c2,eb2,g2,bb2] [ab1,c2,eb2,g2]>").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(8).range(250, 700)).gain(0.85).room(0.3),
    n("<0 3 5 7>").scale("C4:dorian").s("square").decay(0.2).sustain(0).gain(0.45).struct("x ~ ~ ~").vowel("<a o>").room(0.4)
  )],
  [28, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ bd sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(1.05),
    s("hh(11,16,5)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.6).swingBy(0.22, 16).hpf(4800).cut(1).pan(sine.range(0.25,0.75)),
    s("oh ~ oh ~ ~ oh ~ oh").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.42).cut(1),
    s("~ cp ~ ~ ~ cp ~ cp").gain(0.62).room(0.28).every(4, x => x.ply("<1 1 2 3>")),
    s("lt(7,16,4) ht(5,16,2)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.55).coarse(5).every(8, x => x.rev()),
    n("0 ~ 3 0").scale("C2:minor").s("sine").lpf(sine.slow(2).range(380, 1300)).gain(0.95).struct("x ~ x x ~ x x x").shape(0.4),
    n("<0 3 5 7>").scale("C4:dorian").s("square").decay(0.1).sustain(0).gain(saw.slow(1).range(0.3, 0.8)).struct("~ x ~ x ~ x ~ x").crush(6).lpf(2600).off(0.125, x => x.add(note(12)).gain(0.4))
  )],
  [12, stack(
    s("bd ~ ~ ~ sd ~ ~ ~").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.9),
    s("hh(5,16,2)").bank("RolandTR606").gain(0.5).swingBy(0.18, 16).hpf(6000),
    n("0").scale("C2:minor").s("sine").lpf(420).gain(0.8).struct("x ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ x")
  )]
)
